topic.title: Junos Circuit Down Troubleshooting
topic.definition: A circuit is considered down when the physical link, underlying transport LSP, overlay pseudowire/EVPN service binding, or Layer 3 endpoint path is unavailable or materially degraded.

workflow.step: Underlay transport core (IS-IS/OSPF, LDP, RSVP-TE LSPs)
Layer 3 overlay and routing (IP, ARP, BGP)

determineFaultDomain.item: Local physical interface or low SFP optical light level (Rx/Tx)
Local framing, MTU, or VLAN ID tag encapsulation mismatch
Underlay IGP adjacency or core MPLS LSP transport failure
Pseudowire virtual circuit signaling or MTU mismatch
Provider or transport WAN handoff network issue
Overlay routing, BGP peering, or customer CPE configuration

topic.note: Record exact failure time, SFP optical light readings (dBm), pseudowire status history, and affected services before escalating.
